item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:45 HKT 22/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring cool weather in the morning and at night to Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the monsoon moderating slightly midweek this week, daytime temperatures will rise over the coastal areas. Besides, an area of low pressure now over the southern part of the South China Sea will develop gradually and move towards the vicinity of southern Vietnam in the next couple of days. The associated band of clouds will cover the central to northern parts of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of this week. It will become cool over the region.
